# TutorHub Bangladesh — Operations & Memory Platform for Private Tutors

> TutorHub is the modern operations platform, tuition cycle tracking SaaS, and verified university tutor marketplace tailored specifically for private tutors and guardians across Bangladesh.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Cycle Memory & Attendance Tracking**: Solves the #1 friction in Bangladeshi private tutoring—forgetting whether today is class 7 or class 8 of a 12-class cycle.
- **Zero Commission Matching**: Parents post tuition requirements for free; verified university tutors (BUET, DU, DMC, NSU, IBA) connect directly with guardians with zero commission deductions.
- **Instant Verified Credentials**: Tutors upload government NID / birth certificates and university student ID cards for background verification.
- **Transparent Guardian Portal**: Tokenized, friction-free portal where parents review completed cycle milestones, salary receipts, and syllabus progression in real-time.

## Key Public URLs
- [Home & Platform Overview](https://tutorhub.com.bd/): Introduction to TutorHub, guided tour, and interactive features.
- [Tuition Requirement Board](https://tutorhub.com.bd/marketplace): Live directory of verified parent tuition postings across Dhaka and nationwide.
- [Post a Tuition Requirement](https://tutorhub.com.bd/marketplace/create): Portal for guardians to submit requirements with flexible days-per-week or days-per-month schedules.
- [Verified Tutors Directory](https://tutorhub.com.bd/teachers): Search verified university mentors by subject, area, and curriculum.

## Supported Curricula & Mediums
- Bangla Medium (National Curriculum and Textbook Board - NCTB)
- English Version (NCTB)
- English Medium (Edexcel International GCSE / IAL)
- English Medium (Cambridge CAIE O-Level / A-Level)
- Madrasah Board (Dakhil & Alim)

## Locations Served
- Major Dhaka hubs: Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Banani, Uttara, Mirpur, Mohammadpur, Badda, Bashundhara R/A, Lalmatia, Shantinagar, Khilgaon, Old Dhaka.
- Nationwide online tutoring across Chittagong, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Khulna, and all divisions.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints (JSON)
- Marketplace Open Posts: `GET /api/marketplace/posts`
- Public Teacher Directory: `GET /api/teachers`
- Teacher Public Profile: `GET /api/teachers/:slug`

## Security & Verification Standards
- Argon2 password hashing
- HttpOnly JWT access & refresh token rotation
- CSRF protection on mutation requests
- Strict Rate Limiting (express-rate-limit) to thwart brute-force & credential stuffing
